summary: Organizer-facing stage builder: backend CRUD for stages/transitions, a graph-validity endpoint (ST-002), an advancement endpoint listing/running strategies (ST-003), and an evidence endpoint over recent stage.advanced AuditEvents. Stages that ever held a StageEntry can't be deleted. Frontend StageBuilder.tsx (list editing, live validity indicator, advancement form, evidence panel) mounted inside EventDashboard. Found and fixed a real bug: StageTransitionSerializer's UUID-typed from_stage/to_stage tripped DRF's auto UniqueTogetherValidator into filtering an integer FK column with a UUID (SQLite OverflowError) — disabled that validator, the view's IntegrityError handling already covers the constraint. C-B05 (ST-001..005) is complete.
